intended_corrections: Freshly allocated sectors are zeroed before linking to prevent disclosure of previously freed file bytes.
FAT32 reserved high-nibble bits are preserved when updating a packed allocation entry.
A failed read restores its logical cursor and invalidates cached traversal and data-sector state.
Exfat reads beyond valid data length return zero rather than stale sector contents.
synthetic_test_provenance: Tests construct independent FAT directory records, fragmented allocation chains, exfat primary/stream/name sets, bitmap bytes and data sectors in caller-owned byte images. They inspect public reads and reopened catalog metadata rather than private file state. Fault and cancellation SectorIo wrappers inject observable medium failures around the real HostVolume provider.

qualification_limits: NONMATCHING decompilation remains source-inspection evidence, not a binary-equivalence claim; selected wrapper error/lifetime branches were cross-read with original instruction listings.
Compilation and behavioral tests have not been exercised.
ARM SD/FTL, asynchronous actor publication and integrated wireless/USB caller scenarios require integration qualification.
The provider does not claim power-loss atomicity for multi-sector FAT, bitmap or directory updates.
Timestamp acquisition is caller-owned; close_with_options accepts the parsed FAT timestamp.
No proprietary bytes, camera images, SDK fixtures or host filesystem shortcut are included.
